purpose.objective: Advance the Riemann Hypothesis frontier through the highest-value mathematically credible work available: select the next question, delegate adaptively when independent work helps, preserve and interpret useful results, revise Strategy from what was learned, and commit a concise truthful Continuation Checkpoint.
purpose.proof_standard: A genuinely correct, novel, self-contained, independently checkable proof or disproof of the Riemann Hypothesis whose exact statement, dependencies, derivation, assumptions, and verification package withstand independent reconstruction; computation, model confidence, repeated agreement, or system state cannot establish it.
non_goals: Claiming a theorem from finite moments, bounded-degree tests, floating-point evidence, model agreement, or a green verification target.
Owning unrelated application or workflow orchestration.
Treating the system as an automated theorem prover.
Requiring the operator to act as the mathematical strategist or routine proof reviewer, or treating AI agreement as a substitute for checkable mathematics.
Treating an immortal process, unattended daemon, completed Goal, worker count, artifact count, or infrastructure qualification as research success.

closeout_conditions.semantic_effect: Closeout is a Strategy-owned coordination decision; it does not establish proof, disproof, Admission, or research success.

opening_branch.question: For the finite-free polynomial defined in the bundled examples/finite-free-localization/problem.json, do the stated coarse inequalities alone imply a uniform root-localization bound of order sqrt(Bd)? Reproduce the degree-two failure, identify the missing B/D comparability assumption, and check the supplied repaired all-degree statement with its exact remaining assumptions.
opening_branch.leverage_fingerprint: A bounded, reference-assisted reconstruction of a real research correction, followed by a fresh executive retrieving the persisted correction and checking its mathematical scope.
opening_branch.target_hook: This RH-related example examines an auxiliary finite-free polynomial used in a Jensen-polynomial argument. Read examples/finite-free-localization/problem.json, mathematics.md, provenance.md and check.py from this installed release. The public canonical RH state stays open; an auxiliary counterexample or repaired bound is not an RH proof or disproof.
nonclaims: The bounded example does not establish novelty, the full source-paper theorem, a Jensen hyperbolicity range, or RH.
The bundled reference solution and checker are available to the executive. Record the actual reference exposure and execution; do not claim independent historical verification.
The published reconstruction uses its explicitly derived localization constant 10; do not silently substitute the historical proposed constant 9.
The seed supplies an investigation target and no established Evidence, Candidate, canonical admission, or inherited private research records.
This is a new reproduction from disclosed problem and reference material; it is not blind rediscovery or a replay of the private historical run.

strategy.integrated_comparison: The operator selected a bounded reproduction of a documented missing-assumption episode. This fresh workspace starts without results. Complete the supplied finite-free question and one genuine cross-epoch continuation; do not expand to open-ended RH research. In the first executive epoch, read the public inputs, check the counterexample and repaired assumptions, persist usable scoped Evidence and a Candidate when warranted, and commit a continuation Checkpoint with exact record handles and a remaining successor check. Keep Strategy continuation set to continue at that first checkpoint. In the fresh successor epoch, retrieve the predecessor checkpoint and its retained Evidence/Candidate through rh_mission before checking the mathematics from public source. Record what was retrieved, whether B/D <= 4 is retained, and any discrepancy. After that bounded verification, record a truthful Strategy closeout and Checkpoint; completion does not establish any whole-target result.

selected_bets.bet: Reconstruct the finite-free missing-assumption correction and preserve it so a fresh executive can retrieve and check the repaired assumption.
selected_bets.discriminator: Separate the coarse-hypothesis counterexample from the corrected all-degree result. Persist the exact assumptions, derivation, reference exposure and checks actually executed; the successor must retrieve and assess those records. A discovered flaw is a useful result and must not be hidden to force a successful narrative.

attention_actions.consequence: First epoch: preserve correction and exact successor retrieval pointers, then checkpoint with continuation. Fresh successor: retrieve retained records, verify the correction and scope, then close out this bounded example with a final checkpoint.

creativity_treatment.treatment: Use the disclosed degree-two construction and repaired proof as reproducible mathematical inputs. Resolve any discrepancy in those inputs directly rather than treating the historical narrative as authority.
creativity_treatment.decision_consequence: Record the strongest justified scoped conclusion, including an explicit unresolved obligation if a check fails; do not expand this reproduction into a new research program.

reconsideration_conditions.condition: A failed algebraic check, missing assumption, reference mismatch, or inability to retrieve a predecessor record changes what the bounded example can establish.
